reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Tracy Browne
reviews.text: Fitch Services did all the mechanical, electrical and plumbing work at our new house. They handled everything from design through installation and did a wonderful job. All the staff was knowledgeable, considerate and professional. No job was too big or too small, everyone was a joy to work with. Thank you Fitch Services!

reviews.author: Tim Murray
reviews.text: Requested a diagnosis for insufficient hot water from a 14 year old water heater. Fitch had installed it for the prior owners, so I called the number on the sticker. They answered and in a moment had called up all the details and scheduled a service call to check it out. On the scheduled day they came ( earlier than planned with our approval). Diagnosed a wonky thermostat in 5 minutes. Replaced in 30 min. Chad was great, well spoken young man who represented Fitch very well . Clean workspace after his efficient and economical service. Kudos also to Nola at the desk in HQ for good communication. Recommend them.

reviews.author: Betsy Cox
reviews.text: My experience with Fitch was seamless, from the office staff communication to my technician Brian’s thoroughness and professionalism. He uncovered an issue, ensured my system was under warranty, and explained next steps. Prices are fair, and I feel confident the job will be done well. I recommend!

reviews.author: Carson Thompson
reviews.text: We woke up to a broken water pipe on a holiday and, luckily, Fitch's 24 hour emergency response was on the ball. The technician was prompt, very courteous, and thorough in his explanation of the repair. I thought of Fitch first because of their great reputation.

reviews.author: Betsy Cox
reviews.text: Our experience with Fitch has always been great, and Brian is terrific! He is punctual, efficient and explains things thoroughly. We just signed up for an ongoing maintenance plan:)

reviews.author: Megan Stephenson
reviews.text: We were very pleased with our hot water heater replacement. We were scheduled quickly after our assessment. The guys that came had to troubleshoot some issues with our old heater but still got it done pretty quickly. We really appreciate it!

reviews.author: gerry ayres
reviews.text: Fitch has been great. They did a big plumbing job for me. They did an excellent job!! Larry serviced my gas furnace and replaced a part. They are professional, caring and Larry is wonderful!! Knows what he's doing, and very pleasant. Even put booties on to come in the house. Can't say enough good about Fitch and Larry!

reviews.author: Selena Cozart, PhD
reviews.text: I have used Fitch Services several times for heating and plumbing issues and the techs have always been wonderful. Larry was my tech today who installed my smart thermostat and guided me on how to set it up. He arrived on time and was very swift, helpful, and thorough in his service today. I will definitely use Fitch again.

reviews.author: Carly Mount
reviews.text: Huge thanks to Liam at Fitch Services for outstanding emergency electrical help. He walked me through the issue over the phone and helped me handle the situation safely right away. Professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly reassuring. If you need electrical help, ask for Liam at Fitch top-notch service!

reviews.author: Rob Nelms
reviews.text: Jack was polite and professional. He was respectful of our home, knowledgeable and a pleasure to work with. He made good suggestions for additional preventive steps and we followed them. A+++

reviews.author: Geoff Shaw
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience working with Nola and Chad. Chad came to look at the work I needed and they provided a very fair estimate. They were also able to schedule the work within a month of our initial meeting. When they performed the work they were timely, efficient, and kept my house clean - like no one had been there. What great service!

reviews.author: Jodie Stevens
reviews.text: Fitch Services came promptly at my request to insure that my A/C was working correctly. Eric and his assistant were efficient and courteous.

reviews.author: Keith Hammon
reviews.text: Technicians arrived on time and got to work. They cleaned the air handler and installed an air scrubber. I’ve been pleased with their service over the years. I also find the office staff supportive and helpful.

reviews.author: Atalaya Sergi
reviews.text: The Fitch technician arrived on schedule and took time to explain how we can care for the unit. Great experience with Fitch now and over the past few years.

reviews.author: Anne Deane
reviews.text: We lost AC on Friday afternoon of the 4th of July weekend during a 100 degree + heatwave. Fitch sent a team within 24 hours that got us cooling again. Couldn’t ask for better service!

reviews.author: Tina Colom
reviews.text: I was having issues with my HVAC unit and Larry was able to quickly diagnose the issue with the condensate pump which caused the HVAC to shut down when the pump didn't run properly to drain the collected water. I really appreciate his expertise and diligence in evaluating the pump condition and providing a resolution plan with detailed explanation. Thank you!

reviews.author: Heather Standish
reviews.text: Brian serviced our mini split and was knowledgeable and professional. Brian answered all of my questions and educated me about things to be aware of in the future.

reviews.author: Barbara Watson
reviews.text: I have been very pleased with Fitch Services. Brian was the technician and he went beyond the normal visit in determining an issue with my HVAC. He even brought his supervisor back for a consult. I was grateful for their expertise!

reviews.author: Hannah V
reviews.text: The whole team at Fitch was great - from initial scheduling and estimates all the way through to completion of the final work. Danny, our technician, was a superstar. He evaluated our complex plumbing challenges, devised elegant solutions, and executed them flawlessly. We feel confident that the work will stand the test of time and that the plumbing behind our walls is now safe and leak-proof. We had a fantastic experience with Fitch and would highly recommend their work to anyone. Truly a professional operation!

reviews.author: Sam Tomlin
reviews.text: I scheduled a tune-up for my heat pump, gas furnace and an electrical modification to the furnace to allow a generator hook up. Fitch sent a technician for each system and an electrician for the modification. All employees were friendly, knowledgeable, efficient and on time. I am completely satisfied with the services and the pricing was reasonable.

reviews.author: geneva Howard
reviews.text: The two service guys, Chad and Eric, were professional, very pleasant and courteous. They came in a timely manner and fixed my problem and made suggestions. They definitely knew their jobs. I've used this company before and will continue to do so. Kudos to them(5stars).

reviews.author: Jim Bunn
reviews.text: I highly recommend Fitch Services for any of your plumbing, electrical or HVAC needs. Fitch called me 1/2 hour in advance of my scheduled appointment to confirm their technician was on the way. They were on time (5 mins early in fact), were extremely friendly and professional. They will provide me a detailed estimate of work to be done and schedule me at my convenience. You cannot go wrong by choosing their company for your repairs or upcoming project!!!

reviews.author: Donna Klepper
reviews.text: Our new dryer installation came with several challenges, tight space and side venting, complicated by poor delivery and installation from vendor (not Fitch). We called Fitch in to install the dryer and they met the challenge. Thank you, Larry and Chase who worked on the fix along with Jason who made a visit earlier to see if we could install the dryer in the space.

reviews.author: Stan Durtan
reviews.text: I was pleased with Fitch Services handling of my complex repair. Brian worked diligently and efficiently and kept me informed throughout the process. I am a long time customer of Fitch and plan to continue to use their services as needed.

reviews.author: Mary Sandiford
reviews.text: We have used FITCH for heating/ac/plumbing service for 12 years. They have always provided responsive outstanding service. In the past two days we had a heating problem that was not easy to diagnose and resolve. Their owner and team went above and beyond expectations. They came up with a solution. Thank you again FITCH services. The Sandifords, Glenmore, Keswick

reviews.author: Willa N
reviews.text: We just had a new boiler installed by Larry and his team and couldn’t be happier. They communicated clearly every step of the way, installed the system expertly, and even left our basement cleaner than they found it. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Wendi Cook
reviews.text: I’ve used Fitch for several plumbing jobs. They are courteous, prompt, and knowledgeable. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Margaret Gorman
reviews.text: Larry diagnosed and repaired my heat pump and explained how he will address the issue with it at my next seasonal service appointment. It’s January, and I am very appreciative that he could come so quickly and get the heat pump operating again.

reviews.author: Jessica O
reviews.text: We rely on Fitch to keep our radiators in tip-top shape. Service was prompt and efficient; Brian was professional, courteous, and answered all my questions. I definitely recommend Fitch.

reviews.author: Barbara Stafford Vogelsang
reviews.text: I have always been pleased with the quality of work done by Fitch Services. Brian was courteous, efficient, and on time. He was personable and took the time to explain the issue and how to keep it from happening again. I would never hesitate to recommend Fitch Services to anyone.

reviews.author: Norman Ourada
reviews.text: Great service. A nearby lightning strike left my HVAC system nonfunctional. Fitch Services responded with stunning speed: tech Brian arrived less than 90 minutes after I called. Fix turned out to be simple, but it worked. He could have charged me more but did not, because the situation did not really require new parts. Thank you, Brian! Tech Chase has come twice for regular HVAC maintenance and both times was prompt, courteous, and highly effective. In the office, both Nola and Ashley are knowledgeable, pleasant, and highly competent. Fitch Services stands head and shoulders above the other two companies that I have worked with in the past.

reviews.author: Kip Acheson
reviews.text: We have used Fitch for years. They have been very reliable and thorough. Today they advised me of an issue with my A/C but counseled me to check out my warranty. Brian (the Technician)then went through several scenarios to explain options that would be available. I appreciated the time and concern that he had to get me the right solution. We have enjoyed all the technicians that have come to our home. They are reviewing some systems issues with the manufacturer and will get back to me with a plan.

reviews.author: Kelly Mahanes
reviews.text: The technicians are always great and helpful. I also want to point out the team that schedules the service is amazing! They are always super helpful and joy to speak with over the phone

reviews.author: Michelle Abshire
reviews.text: During routine maintenance as part of our covered plan Brian identified an issue with the heat rise. He cane back within a week with Jason to check out the system. They identified an issue with the regulator pressure and fixed it right away. Very thorough and efficient.

reviews.author: Katharine Paljug
reviews.text: Fitch is always our first call for any plumbing, HVAC, or electrical issues, and we've been consistently impressed by the technicians who have helped us out. They're always quick to arrive, friendly, and focused on the job. More importantly, they always clearly explain whatever problem they've diagnosed and walk us through the steps they'll take to fix it so we understand exactly what's going on with the systems in our home.

reviews.author: Stephanie Weldy
reviews.text: After some early season AC issues, I called Fitch for a second opinion on an astronomical quote that another HVAC company recommended. Not only was Larry personable and knowledgeable, he was helpful and kind in resolving the issue WITHOUT a huge price tag. I trust their judgement and appreciate the excellent and neighborly service. What a team! Thank you Larry and Nola for taking such care with getting our family’s HVAC issue resolved. 5 stars, definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Chris De Pree
reviews.text: Larry from Fitch Services saved us from an icy house today. He is always knowledgeable, efficient and friendly. Great technician and company! Thanks!

reviews.author: Robert Emery
reviews.text: Forget all the national names. Forget the funny radio ads rely on a local company that I’ve used for over 30 years. I came back from vacation yesterday, and found my basement full of water. Dead sump pump, dead water heater, dead furnace. I called multiple contractors in desperation. Everyone screwed up except Fitch.. They got everything fixed with efficiency, great communication, and terrific work. Real people solving real problems.

reviews.author: caroline snead
reviews.text: Danny was excellent! Prompt and kind and sweet to my dog who very excited to meet him! Service was superb. Such a relief to have someone we can call to fix problems in our home. Highly recommend Fitch services.

reviews.author: Michelle Streeter
reviews.text: We've had nothing but great experiences with Fitch services. Their customer service is great and they are very timely and professional in getting to projects. They may be a bit pricier than some other similar services, but honestly, they are trustworthy and reliable and that makes them worth going back to over and over again for us.

reviews.author: Joe Durovey
reviews.text: Great guy, speed to house and simple fix and gone in less than 30 minutes 10 stars if you have them.

reviews.author: Chip & Amanda Dunkum
reviews.text: Our AC suddenly quit working on us yesterday, so we gave Fitch Services a call this morning. We were given a 12-4 PM window for the technician to arrive. It’s now 2:05 PM and Larry has already come & gone. He was super quick to diagnose & fix the problem. His customer service was excellent and the company’s pricing is very reasonable given the area in which we live. 10/10 experience and would definitely recommend!

reviews.author: David Schlesinger
reviews.text: Fitch Services has always provided us excellent service for our HVAC system. In this case, Brian, our technician, came out on a long 98 degree day, completely drenched in sweat, and patiently worked through reasons our system might not be keeping up. He answered all of my questions and did a thorough job. I’m grateful for the help!

reviews.author: Jeanne Hucek
reviews.text: The folks at Fitch Services can always be counted on! From the office staff to the technicians- really good people! They are knowledgeable, courteous and work to help us find effective affordable solutions to our plumbing needs. Definitely our go to plumbers!

reviews.author: Nancy Hankinson
reviews.text: Brian was a great technician. I find that all Fitch employees go the extra mile to complete the task at hand. Brian was careful and meticulous as he traveled through my house changing multiple filters as well as explaining my service. He wasn't hard sell, but rather took a more conservative approach by offing only necessary service (for now!).

reviews.author: Kerem Cosar
reviews.text: Fitch on overall is a very reliable and professional service. We work with them for all our residential plumbing, water & air issues. Both the technicians and the scheduling & billing departments do their jobs well, on time and with curtesy. One of the best service companies in Charlottesville.

reviews.author: Annemieke Hutt
reviews.text: Brian was ontime, courteous and got the job done in a timely fashion. He gave me a few good suggestions on how to service the existing Electrostatic air cleaner which I will use. Thanks

reviews.author: Jeanne Jackson
reviews.text: We’ve used Fitch Services for decades and appreciate the professional, friendly service they consistently provide. We know we can rely on their skilled technicians to keep our HVAC system running well. They are a pleasure to work with!

reviews.author: Austen Junior
reviews.text: Fitch services has consistently been there for our plumbing needs! They are excellent at prioritizing issues and quick to schedule. Specifically, our recent technician, Danny, was prompt, polite, and provided a thorough explanation on the services provided. Will continue to call Fitch for our future needs based on this experience!

reviews.author: Lori
reviews.text: Very impressed with Fitch Services. I called in the morning about electrical and HVAC projects, and the electrician showed up within two hours to do a walkthrough for a quote. The HVAC team showed up the next morning as promised and also did a thorough walkthrough for a quote. Scheduling staff are friendly and efficient and keep you updated on technician arrival times. Technicians are extremely knowledgeable and take the time to understand your project and allow you to ask questions. They answer honestly and do not try to upsell you. Great experience so far!

reviews.author: Jo Pettitt
reviews.text: Brian was great!! He came within the 4-hour window given; he was very nice; and he restored our air-conditioning with a price that pleasantly surprised us. WE were, of course, very pleased with the service!

reviews.author: Jim Bowden
reviews.text: Excellent service! Danny came out on the weekend to repair a leaking pressure tank T pipe, when no other service could help. He managed to get replacement parts even though the plumbing supply company was closed for the weekend. I’m very satisfied with the rapid response and the quality of the work performed. Disaster averted!

reviews.author: Marla
reviews.text: Chad installed an under sink water filter. He was very professional, competent, and nice to boot. I would definitely use Fitch plumbers again.

reviews.author: Barbara Olin
reviews.text: We have had an HVAC system maintenance agreement for many years. Brian, the service technician, was efficient, professional, and friendly. We have had this experience on each visit.

reviews.author: David Boling
reviews.text: Fitch was great, we will definitely use them again. I called them around 8:30 in the morning and they had someone out by 1030 to fix our thermostat problem. Very professional and very efficient. Very happy with Jason and the whole Fitch team.

reviews.author: Justin Blessing
reviews.text: Found out downstairs unit was not cooling at 630pm. Called after hours number, they had a tech onsite quickly and working again by 830pm. I can't expect better service than that on one of the hottest days of the year so far. Prices were fair/very reasonable and shout out to Liam for being super professional.

reviews.author: Chris Stewart
reviews.text: Fitch services technicians are always knowledgeable and do great work on installations and repairs. The front desk assistants are professional and kind. Latest work was a same day fix for a broken heat pump capacitor.

reviews.author: Levi Smith
reviews.text: Fitch Services exceeded my expectations! Technician Larry was a pleasure to work with. He quickly and politely listened to my AC issue, immediately diagnosed it, and had it fixed within 10 minutes. Our AC is now running perfectly! Highly recommend their prompt and professional service.

reviews.author: Laura Burns
reviews.text: Brian came to tune up my furnace on 12/4/25. As always, he was knowledgeable,professional, and extremely pleasant. It’s a good feeling to know my heating system is in good working order for the cold weather to come!

reviews.author: Roberta Whitehurst
reviews.text: What life savers Fitch Services is! Of course on the hottest days of the year our ac gave out. Larry called within 10 minutes and arrived 30 minutes later. He had us up & running within 30 minutes. He was kind, knowledgeable and took care of our issues!!! Highly, highly recommend Fitch Services!

reviews.author: Ryan Tanner
reviews.text: I've been using Fitch Services for seven years and have always been very happy with the quality of their work and ease of communication. They've installed and worked on my A/C, furnace, and water heater, and always fit me in for repairs quickly. Now that I'm at a new address, they just completed a furnace replacement and I continue to be impressed.

reviews.author: Zax Bit (ZaxBit)
reviews.text: I contacted Fitch for some regular servicing because I knew they’d give me the time of day compared to other huge HVAC businesses in Cville. Brian was extremely friendly and responsive to our questions about our aging HVAC! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Joe
reviews.text: Jack was excellent and I highly recommend Fitch for their professionalism and customer service. Fair pricing on my HVAC maintenance and the system that they installed a year ago has been running flawlessly.

reviews.author: Harry Montague
reviews.text: We had copper water pipes that were breaking down and springing leaks. Contacted Fitch to give us an estimate on replacing all of the water pipes. Chad came out and discussed how he would do the job and gave us a quote. We scheduled the work, they showed up when scheduled and managed to complete the whole project in one long day. They did a good job of minimizing the disruption and cleaned up their mess. We totally recommend their work.

reviews.author: Elisabeth Sloan
reviews.text: We are very long term customers of Fitch Services. When we renovated our home in the mid 1990s we used Fitch Services for HVAC and electrical improvements. In the early 2000s Fitch replaced all of our plumbing. We are thoroughly satisfied customers, who strongly recommend this quality company to meet your heating, cooling, power, and plumbing needs. Yesterday evening our boiler pump was leaking water. I called. Early this morning the Fitch team arrived and analyzed the situation. We had repaired boiler a few hours later. Fitch services is reliable and dependable. Thank you for consistently meeting our home’s needs.

reviews.author: Lewis N.
reviews.text: Trevor showed up exactly at the time i was told he would and thats important to me people keeping their word. He was knowledgeable and explained what he was going to do and had it fixed in no time. He was a great representative for Fitch services and i will definitely use them again when needed. Im new to the area and was looking for a reputable plumber/company when my leak happened, glad that the people i asked recommended them.

reviews.author: Kelly Kroese
reviews.text: We've been clients of Fitch Services and we've been very happy with their services. Brent has always been especially attentive to my partner's concerns, and Danny did a great job this last time out. Thanks Fitch!

reviews.author: Arimas athos
reviews.text: Yes, i am very happy with the service I received from Jason. Professional, positive personality, knowledgeable….. I felt very comfortable with Jason as he diagnosed the problem and offered solutions. The real test is, would I call Fitch Services again or recommend them to a neighbor? Absolutely!

reviews.author: Denise Mathew
reviews.text: Fitch Services re-piped our entire house recently and the overall experience and level of workmanship exceeded our expectations. Technicians Jason and Chris are professional, friendly, experienced and knowledgeable and the Front Office staff are a pleasure to work with. Jason and Chris made over 200 perfect and solid connections; not one leak. We were so impressed by the care they took to protect our things with plastic and to minimize drywall dust. The quality of their work is just awesome and the cost was reasonable and competitive. We highly recommend Fitch Services and will call them for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Kevin Gallagher
reviews.text: We use Fitch for regular maintenance and have always appreciated the full team's professionalism, diligence, responsiveness and fair pricing. During the recent heat wave and on a Sunday our HVAC stopped working. We called Fitch and within 2 hours, Liam was at our house to replace a capacitor. He was professional, courteous, and great to work with. Thank you Fitch!

reviews.author: Wayne Riddle
reviews.text: We have always found Fitch’s services to be reliable and timely. In the latest example, Brian efficiently diagnosed and repaired a complicated problem with our HVAC system.

reviews.author: Tom Bath
reviews.text: Got $2000 estimate from another local company Brian from Finch services had me up and running in less than five minutes! Finch services is absolutely the way to go. Don’t even think of calling someone else. Thanks so much!!!!!!

reviews.author: Yelena Peskova
reviews.text: Very prompt response after the hours, great advice over the phone, help with scheduling and a very efficient repair of the furnace next noon. Very attentive receptionist and a knowledgeable technician.

reviews.author: Marcia Silvermetz
reviews.text: Fitch has such an excellent team. Jason and Brandon put in my new mini split system and new water heater. They are super nice and trustworthy guys. I also had a main water line put in and sewer cleaning in the past, and Chris was the main plumber. Excellent service with plumbing, too. I have sent them to my neighbor for sewer work. The office staff is wonderful, too. They are my go to company.

reviews.author: Chris Thomas
reviews.text: Bryan was early for our appointment, professional, and explained in detail what was wrong. He explained options without pressure to choose the expensive option. Always pleased with service from Fitch.

reviews.author: Joseph Claus
reviews.text: Fitch Services and Chase took care of us on an emergency call at night and got our AC back up and running in 90 degree weather. He was professional, courteous, and worked quickly to resolve our issues. We will definitely use Fitch Services again!

reviews.author: Huy Ta
reviews.text: We had three ceiling fans installed in our house. Fitch was on time, friendly, and professional. They cleaned up any mess that was created and finished the job rather promptly. Besides the small holes above the light switches, which I believe was necessary to run the electrical wiring, we are very happy with the result, and would recommend them to anyone looking for their services.

reviews.author: Steve Sellers
reviews.text: Shannon our HVAC technician arrived on time. He was courteous and professional. The reason for the visit was a routine maintenance call. Shannon found a component which was on the verge of failing and replaced it. Great experience as always with Fitch!

reviews.author: Charles Johnston
reviews.text: New review 10/14/2022 - Thomas was just here to do our Fall system service. He was on time, prepared, very courteous and extremely helpful. He didn't mind me asking questions. He was efficient as well. This is one reason I have continued to use Fitch for years. Side note - I didn't realize they also did plumbing but will keep that in mind for future needs! Just had our heat pump replaced ($ ouch!), but these folks made it a little less painful. Jason and his partner were terrific - very professional, clean, and efficient - and it was 90+ degrees (probably over 100 in the attic!). Fitch has been doing our regular bi-annual service for years. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Tom Panarese
reviews.text: I've used Fitch for a few years now for both electrical and plumbing work. They are professional and do a great job on things both big and small. Twice we have had pretty huge jobs and they have come in under budget. Plus, the service technicians are friendly and work hard and the office staff communicates very well. Definitely recommend!

reviews.author: Julie W.
reviews.text: We have used Fitch now for 3 years. They have installed a water softener and dishwasher, replaced all 3 toilets and all 3 hose bibs (one had busted). Always so pleased with the gentlemen that came out. All were so polite and knowledgeable, efficient neat and clean with their work. Very respectful of our home. Prices were more than reasonable. A real pleasure to work with!

reviews.author: Rob Leventhal
reviews.text: Fitch Services installed both of our A/C units and provides excellent, prompt, courteous service. Larry spent extra time explaining how to program our Honeywell thermostat. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Howie Fendley
reviews.text: Very best service and support on lots of home repairs. I have had Fitch handle several things at my home including dishwasher, garbage disposal, gas range, and most recently whole new heat pump/AC unit. Every single technician that came to my house was polite, professional, and knowledgeable. Service was always completed professionally within my budget. Prices are competitive locally and quality of work is outstanding.

reviews.author: David Singerman
reviews.text: Fitch is the best. We began using them on the recommendation of a longtime local coffee shop owner. They’ve done electrical work for us, fixed plumbing, and recently installed three mini-splits. The company’s owner himself came out to do the consultation on the mini split system. The techs are always professional, helpful, patient, respectful, knowledgeable, and friendly, and they never upsell or overcharge. The dispatching/scheduling staff is also friendly and helpful and has been there ever since we started using them, and they’ll make an extra effort to help out longtime customers. Really cannot say enough good stuff. Use Fitch, you won’t be sorry.

reviews.author: Tasha Tobin
reviews.text: I have been a client for years. Excellent repair service on all needs: HVAC, generator, plumbing and electric. The servicemen are friendly and very knowledgeable and always go the extra mile. The office is just as lovely to work with. I give Fitch a high recommendation, they always solve my home issues from leaky faucets to broken attic fans and know my house well.

reviews.author: Reese Erwin
reviews.text: Superb service. Found hot water heater leak on Sat.afternoon. Within l/2 hr.of phone call, Fitch technician was on the job. He found suitable replacement and next morning, Sunday, at 8:15, crew arrived with new unit and installed it. Competent, prompt, courteous. Have used Fitch some 20 years for HVAC, plumbing, electric and cannot recommend them highly enough. I like supporting locally-owned businesses that are totally trustworthy.

reviews.author: Lisa Gorsch
reviews.text: Just as the summer heat topped out, our A/C failed. Fitch was able to send someone out right away to diagnose a leaking coil. Jason, the lead technician, was pleasant, efficient and very understanding of the urgency of the situation. He was able to come back within two days to install the new coil. Expensive, but worth it!

reviews.author: Joan Miller
reviews.text: Trevor has been to my house on a few occasions for repairs I needed. He is always so pleasant and knowledgeable getting the work done efficiently. Thank you for the fast and speedy service calls. Joan

reviews.author: Ann-Marie Schare
reviews.text: Brian and his assistant were prompt and explained what problems they found and corrected. We looked at the installation date of the unit and determined the life expectancy of the unit and when it may need to be replaced. We have only had two service calls in 12 years. Many thanks. Peter

reviews.author: Constance Wright
reviews.text: Danny and Larry did excellent work to repair my AC. They were efficient, polite, and got the job done. I have been a Fitch customer for 12 years.

reviews.author: Linda Hitt
reviews.text: Fitch services came when they were scheduled to, carefully explained the heat pump problems and how they can be resolved Very Curtious and helpful! They plan to repair heat pump soon when the part is in. Thanks to Brian and Jack!

reviews.author: Anthony Tonti
reviews.text: Fitch has fixed plumbing and electrical issues 3 times over the past 4 years. They are consistently excellent, efficient, reliable and nice. Can't think of anyone else we would call. Tony T.

reviews.author: B Simpson
reviews.text: Danny came quickly and repaired our leak fast. He was professional, courteous, and efficient. I would call Fitch Services again without hesitation.

reviews.author: Jerome J. Liebman (Jerry)
reviews.text: We lost heat this morning. I called Fitch a little before 10:00 am. Our technician, Jason, was here with his assistant by 11:00 am. They diagnosed the problem quickly and got us up and running by around 11:30. The guys were great! Very professional.

reviews.author: Jack and Terry Hickey
reviews.text: We had a flood under the kitchen sink. Fitch came within an hour and corrected the problem. Very professional, courteous, knowledgeable. We use Fitch for all our hvac also and they are competent and easy to deal with.

reviews.author: Serena Nappi
reviews.text: We’ve used Fitch several times over the last few years and we’ve always been happy with the job they have done. The techs are prompt, polite, and committed to doing a quick and excellent job. We highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Haden
reviews.text: Fitch plumber, Danny, provided professional service. He arrived in a timely manner, he was knowledgeable, courteous and friendly, and he resolved our plumbing issue quickly and effectively.

reviews.author: Katie Junior
reviews.text: Danny arrived at our house with a warm hello and offered a professional experience from start to finish. He quickly addressed the plumbing issue and then took time to walk us through the problem and resolution. We so appreciate you, Danny!

reviews.author: Matthew Given
reviews.text: Everything about my experience with Fitch has been fantastic. From Patty who handles scheduling to Brent who made the service call, everyone was incredibly friendly and helpful. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a fair price and exceptional service.

reviews.author: Katie Black
reviews.text: I have used Fitch Services 4 different times. Three times for electrical work and one time for plumbing. With each service I have had a very positive experience with professional staff and excellent results. They are reliable and dependable and I will continue to use them in the future.

reviews.author: Arin Bennett
reviews.text: I've used Fitch for two separate home installations - both were completed professionally and promptly and prices were fair and in line with other companies. I'm very pleased with Fitch's workmanship and responses to questions after installation. I'd be happy to use them again.

reviews.author: Rich Knox
reviews.text: Arrived within the designated time frame. Came into house with the anticipated parts and needed tools. Danny completed the job in about four minutes. Checked his work and was done.

reviews.author: Kieran O'Loughlin
reviews.text: Fitch Services did our recent Air Conditioning checkup. The technician arrived on time and was extremely helpful, answering questions, etc. He did the job quickly, and even brought forms for Dominion's tune-up program. We didn't even have to pay as the Dominion program covered the cost!

reviews.author: Sara Robinson
reviews.text: For over 20 years we have used Fitch. We have been pleased and any issues that came up were quickly and fairly resolved. Patty is great to work with in setting appointments and getting service scheduled.

reviews.author: Dan O'Donnell
reviews.text: Our oil furnace would not stay running. Fitch was able to fit us in to an appointment on short notice. (and this is their busy December time) Brandon observed the operation, made some adjustments, and had it running in one half hour. I will difinitely use Fitch again. Thanks Brandon

reviews.author: William Campbell
reviews.text: We enjoyed the work that Chad and Trevor did for our family. It was timely and very professional. We felt it was fair and honest.

reviews.author: David Plunkett
reviews.text: Can’t say enough about Fitch and their electrician Liam in particular. Electric meter ripped off our house and he worked Friday evening and Saturday to get power back as soon as possible. Extremely helpful in navigating reconnection with third parties, and mindful of the property while reinstalling. Absolutely recommend.

reviews.author: Kristen Carty
reviews.text: We've used Fitch for all our home and rental property repairs for years. The people are very kind and knowledgable, the prices are below the competition, and the HVAC technicians are the best in the business!

reviews.author: Joan Hodskins
reviews.text: Fitch Services provided another excellent biannual inspection of our home HVAC system and serviced it accordingly. Thank you, Brian!

reviews.author: Eric Ramirez-Weaver
reviews.text: Extraordinary, swift and incredibly knowledgeable service! Our problem was diagnosed before anyone had even gotten downstairs. Repairs were explained, clean and executed with the utmost professionalism.

reviews.author: Chip Murray
reviews.text: We have consistently had excellent experiences with Fitch Services for all of our HVAC, electrical, and plumbing needs. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: BarrySheryl Horowitz
reviews.text: Jason and Bradley cleaned up a mechanical and financial mess left by our former HVAC company. They were knowledgeable, professional, patient and helpful. Most of all, they fixed everything!

reviews.author: susan
reviews.text: I've had Fitch Services come to my house twice for plumbing needs. They are very knowledgeable, professional, and efficient. I would highly recommend them for these services. Jonathan was a pleasure to work with!

reviews.author: Linda Hanson
reviews.text: The team installing my new HVAC system was cheerfully efficient, respectful, and attentive to detail. They communicated clearly and cleaned up after themselves. I'm grateful!

reviews.author: Patrick H
reviews.text: I'm a landlord and homeowner in Charlottesville, and I've used Fitch many times over the years. They always show up on time and do a great job. If there are any problems with a repair, or emergencies, Patty always gets a team out same day to fix it without any hassle. Good people!

reviews.author: Bill Baskerville
reviews.text: I called Fitch Plumbing for a leak just before a big snow storm. They arrived promptly as promised and completed the work in a timely manner, were friendly, cleaned up their mess and presented a reasonable bill. I recommend them.

reviews.author: Mark Sackson
reviews.text: Danny was great. Showed up early, fixed the leak in 30 minutes. Really nice guy. Fitch was easy to work with.

reviews.author: Ralph Hall
reviews.text: Jason and Bradley arrived on schedule, were very polite and respectful and did a great job. It was a pleasure having them working in my house.

reviews.author: Christa Stewart
reviews.text: Jack was very respectful and knowledgeable. He kept us in the loop throughout the process. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Taylor Titus
reviews.text: Fitch Services is our go to for just about every home service repair. They are prompt and thorough in their explanations.

reviews.author: Virginia Henderson
reviews.text: Friendly, Prompt, Professional. Brent did a great job unclogging our kitchen drain. Will definitely use Fitch Services again.

reviews.author: Erica Flora
reviews.text: Always there for our family operated rental business when we can'tmake it toba unit. Speedy resolution, great customer service, will take time to walk through multiple solutions and doesn't always push the most expensive option.

reviews.author: Jake Minturn
reviews.text: Fair pricing, good work, nice folks, and prompt service. We've had to do significant plumbing work at our house and have been very pleased with everything Fitch has done for us.

reviews.author: Jeremy Lloyd
reviews.text: Larry added insulation around unit and a safety switch on drain. Work completed neatly and everywhere left immaculate. Very glad to have Larry do this work for us.

reviews.author: Todd Cabell
reviews.text: Excellent service. Chad was prompt, courteous, and very informative. He answered all my questions and walked me through the work in detail. Very happy with the service.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Wooding
reviews.text: Good information and explanation of HVAC problem. Had replacement part in truck, knowledgeable, not allergic to our cats.

reviews.author: Steinar Knutsen
reviews.text: I've used Fitch Services on multiple jobs including air duct installation, electrical hookup, air conditioning repair, and plumbing. They always treat us with respect and offer a fair price.

reviews.author: Bob DuCharme
reviews.text: After we found the problem on Friday night it was great to have Danny out here on Saturday morning. He fixed the problem quickly and had good answers for all my questions about the problem and the fix.

reviews.author: Brian Peterson
reviews.text: Fitch’s must pride themselves on punctuality because their service truck was driving like a bat out of hell on a cold icy morning, almost running me off the road. But I have to give it to them for trying to help their customers as quickly as possible.

reviews.author: Joe Thorndike
reviews.text: Came right away, fixed our AC problem at reasonable cost. Another great experience (of many) with Fitch Services.

reviews.author: Thomas E. Huerta
reviews.text: Trevor and Chase, were great good work. Very friendly and approachable. They kept me posted and explained everything to me.

reviews.author: Charlotte Drummond
reviews.text: These guys are great. They stuck with the problem and made two trips out to get parts, but in the end, my heat was working correctly!

reviews.author: Nicole Richardson
reviews.text: Good experience with knowledgeable technicians. I appreciated receiving an advance call announcing when techs would arrive. They answered all my questions, were friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Paul M. Boggs
reviews.text: "As I also commented on both Facebook and Angie's List this was a good experience. The service was performed as scheduled and well. There was a glitch in the billing (which can happen in any business) but their own people detected it and contacted me about it and took care of it on their own initiative. Greatly appreciated!"

reviews.author: Brady Zimmerman
reviews.text: What a great experience! Technician fixed all issues and did his due diligence. Not only did he fix it but he went above and beyond. Found my new go to!

reviews.author: Hamp Carruth
reviews.text: Very efficient service. After checking the furnace, Brian quickly spotted the problem and solved it. Well done.

reviews.author: Laurel Lorigan
reviews.text: I have always had a great experience the several times I’ve used Fitch- they respond quickly and are very helpful.
